summary: Phase 4 Caufid progression awareness tested end-to-end. Backend (5/5 pytest): (1) Phase 3 regression — /api/atlas/progression/hub still returns 9-item levels array (Curious..Master, thresholds 0..8000). (2) Source inspection confirms get_progression_data is declared in TOOLS schema with proper name/description/parameters, wired in execute_tool dispatcher, calling services.progression_service.get_progression_hub. (3) ATLAS_SYSTEM_PROMPT contains section 111-115 PROGRESSION AWARENESS with all required directives (analyze strengths/weaknesses, celebrate achievements, use tool for latest metrics, do not fabricate). (4) build_context() injects 'PROGRESSION SUMMARY:' block with level, XP, streak, modules stats, quiz stats and 5 skill scores. (5) Real chat calls — POST /api/atlas/chat with 'Analyze my progress...' (EN) and 'Analyse ma progression...' (FR) both return 200 within ~15s and reply text references real progression data (matched keywords: xp/finance/crypto/level/badge/skill in EN, niveau/xp/compet in FR). Frontend: login via 'I have an account' modal + Enter works. Progress tab renders hero (Level 1 Curious, 80 XP, 20 XP → Explorer bar), quick stats (0 streak / 3 badges / 0 modules), Priority card (RESUME Débuter en crypto), Today's goals (3 items with XP rewards), Skills section (5 skills at 0/10). Scrolled and located [data-testid='analyze-progression-btn'] CTA. Clicking CTA correctly (a) switches to Chat tab, (b) auto-sends the prefilled analysis message ('Analyze my progress in detail...' bubble shown), (c) shows 'Caufid is thinking' loader, (d) produces a response that references user progression data (keywords found: xp, finance, crypto, niveau).
critical_code_review_comments: learn.tsx now ~1950 lines — repeat of iter 100 recommendation: extract ProgressView + 4 detail modals into /components/progression/*. Adding the CTA in the same file made it larger.

Chat response body key inconsistency risk: the test tolerated 'response'|'message'|'reply'|'answer'. Consider standardising the /api/atlas/chat response schema and documenting it, so front-end / tools can rely on a single key.

The CTA auto-sends the prefilled message on tab switch (via initialMessage prop). Consider staging the text in the input first so the user can edit before send — currently there is no way to cancel, and each click creates a new conversation entry (visible: 5 duplicate 'Analyse ma progression' conversations already in sidebar).

build_context() progression summary is injected unconditionally on every chat turn. For long conversations this bloats the system context; consider injecting only on the first turn or when the user's message mentions progression keywords.

get_progression_data tool duplicates data already in PROGRESSION SUMMARY context — model may still call the tool wastefully. Prompt could explicitly say 'call the tool only if you need detailed skill/badge breakdowns; otherwise use the summary'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (CTA visible, click switches tab, message sent, AI response contains progression keywords)

seed_data_creation: None (chat created 1 new 'Analyze my progress in detail...' conversation in test account history)
